# Tender response -- DKS-2026-007

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla

## 3. Eligibility

3.2 Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio per its most recent audited financial statements (FY2025) is 35.2%, exceeding the 20% threshold required.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 We propose a comprehensive HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement covering preventive inspection rounds, seasonal adjustment of plant, and rapid-response corrective works, delivered by our 62-strong LVI team.

4.3 Fire-protection systems are maintained on a scheduled inspection regime in line with manufacturer intervals and Finnish statutory requirements, with documented sign-off after each visit.

4.4 Equipment installed under the contract carries a standard 24-month warranty from commissioning.

4.5 Waste generated on site is segregated at source (metals, electronics, refrigerants, general) and removed via licensed waste contractors, with documentation available to the buyer on request.

4.6 Service continuity through personnel changes is managed through cross-trained teams and documented handover procedures; our technical staff (LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito combined) number over 160, giving depth well beyond a single named engineer per site.

4.7 Standard-stock spare parts are held at our Jyvaskyla depot; parts not held in stock are typically delivered within 3-5 working days.

4.8 Environmental matters during works are managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 certified environmental management system.

4.9 Our personnel will observe the buyer's access-control and site-security procedures as briefed at induction, including badge issuance and visitor-log discipline for all site visits.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Visakoivu's standard limitation-of-liability clause caps our liability at the contract value per claim, per annum.

5.2 All prices below are quoted in EUR.

5.3 We propose a retention of 5% on each invoice, released on satisfactory completion of the contract year.

## 6. Enclosures

6.1 A description of Visakoivu's environmental management system (NMSB 74210:2015) is enclosed.

6.2 A certificate of Visakoivu's pension insurance payments is enclosed.

## 7. Format

7.1 Pricing is quoted per square metre.

7.2 This quotation is submitted as a single PDF, not password-protected.

7.3 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year.

## Liite A

A.1 We offer the following SLA targets: critical faults responded to within 4 hours, non-critical within 24 hours.

A.2 Our building automation systems are fully compatible with BACnet and Modbus protocols.

A.3 Fault-report response time is 4 hours for critical issues; a 24/7 standby (on-call) rota covers evenings, weekends and public holidays.

A.4 Routine maintenance visits are scheduled monthly for mechanical plant and quarterly for automation systems, with content agreed in the maintenance plan.

## Liite B

B.1 We accept a bonus/malus arrangement tied to the SLA targets in Section 4.

B.2 CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract are enclosed.

B.3 A list of proposed subcontractors is enclosed as Liite 3.
